THE AGENT ERA

Payment

• Value should move like information - instant, borderless, open to anyone or anything.
• GOAT enables frictionless payments across networks and applications, eliminating intermediaries and settlement delays.
• Powered by x402 protocol and cross-chain routing.

Settlement

• Capital should not sit idle.
• GOAT provides real BTC-denominated yield generated by real network activity.
• Rules execute automatically, allowing people and AI agents to manage capital on equal terms.

trust mechanism

• Trust should be earned, not granted.
• Every participant carries a verifiable on-chain identity through ERC-8004.
• Goat Scan inspects any address or agent.
• Bounty Market automates task execution and settlement.

Our Value

Why GOAT Network?

VIEW MORE

GOAT Network provides secure, scalable infrastructure that enables AI agents, users, and institutions to collaborate, transact, and settle, while preserving Bitcoin’s core principles of security and self-custody.

to collaborate, transact, and settleandsettle, while preserving Bitcoin’s core principles of security and self-custody.

Your BTC finally works for you.

Deposit Bitcoin, earn real yield from network activity. Every return is verifiable on-chain, no hidden sources.

Infrastructure your compliance team can approve.

• Yield comes from BTC-denominated gas fees and $GOATED from protocol activity • Distributed through transparent, on-chain mechanisms • Designed for long-term BTC holders and institutions

A Bitcoin platform where agents operate independently.

• Scale Bitcoin with a Type-1 zkEVM. The Type-1 zkEVM - powered by our in-house zkVM, Ziren, and supports real-time proving - enables builders to build the native DeFi with BTC • A robust developer toolchain and ecosystem, allowing developers to leverage native EVM-compatible tools to build applications with seamless interoperability across protocols, including Swap, Lending, and GameFi.

From its underlying BitVM2 architecture to its developer and user tools, GOAT Network is built on and relies on the highest security standards in blockchain. Palmera
